name: The Scribe's Tower
description: Ink, glass and wandwood. Every scroll the guild carries and every spell it seals for the fight is made here.

tiers.description: Scribe overworld scrolls, and seal Common spells in glass.
Seal Uncommon spells. A field party's wands recharge at any staging anchor or the parked castle, not only at home.
A doctrine, chartered at the Grand Hall. The Glasswright: Rare glass, and glass that keeps your card's upgrades. Or the Wandwright: rebind any wand to a spell the guild knows.

doctrines.name: The Glasswright
doctrines.description: Rare spells can be sealed, and a glass keeps the upgrades your best copy of the card carries. Every belt in the guild carries your finished spells.

doctrines.name: The Wandwright
doctrines.description: Rebind any wand to an aimable Common or Uncommon spell the guild knows. A Fighter fires your frost three times an expedition.
